about:
Martin's Equipment, Inc. operates from Statesville, North Carolina, and has served the region since its founding in 1996. The company sells new and used commercial restaurant equipment to both the public and industry professionals across North Carolina and surrounding states.

The company stocks a broad range of commercial kitchen categories including ice machines, refrigeration, cooking equipment, dishwashing and sanitation, food preparation, and dining room supplies. In addition to sales, Martin's Equipment purchases used restaurant equipment — from single items to entire kitchen liquidations — and handles removal and transport. New and used inventory arrives daily at their physical location, which is open Monday through Friday.

Customers range from independent restaurant owners and chefs to institutional food-service operators throughout North Carolina and neighboring states. The company works with anyone needing commercial kitchen equipment, whether outfitting a new location, replacing a single fryer, or clearing out a closing establishment.

Martin's Equipment emphasizes competitive pricing on both new and used inventory, and promotes its ability to complete most liquidations within the seller's required timeframe using its own removal equipment and transport.
